en.headline: Tram hits elderly woman in North Point as services briefly suspended
en.dek: A westbound tram struck a woman at the King's Road junction with Kam Hong Street at 7:19am; she was conscious and taken to Eastern Hospital, with services on Shu Kuk Street resuming at 8:12am.
body: Police and the Transport Department said a westbound tram hit an elderly woman at the junction of King's Road and Kam Hong Street in North Point at about 7:19am on Wednesday.
The woman was conscious after the collision and was taken by ambulance to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital for treatment. The cause of the accident is under investigation.

Westbound tram services along Shu Kuk Street were suspended for a time while the scene was cleared. The Transport Department announced that services had returned to normal by 8:12am and advised passengers to use other public transport in the interim.

zh.headline: 北角電車撞倒過路婦 書局街西行線一度暫停
zh.dek: 今早約7時19分一輛西行電車於英皇道與琴行街交界撞倒一名婦人，她清醒送東區醫院，書局街西行電車服務至8時12分恢復正常。
body: 警方及運輸署表示，星期三早上約7時19分，一輛西行電車在北角英皇道與琴行街交界撞倒一名老婦。
婦人受傷後仍然清醒，由救護車送往東區醫院治理。意外原因仍在調查中。
事發後書局街的西行線電車服務一度暫停以清理現場。運輸署其後宣布服務於早上8時12分已恢復正常，並呼籲市民在期間考慮使用其他公共交通工具。
